title: Lip Sync
description: Makes one person's lips in an existing clip follow a voice track; same size, fps and frame count, only the mouth area changes.

controls.label: Face index (0 = leftmost, used when Face = index)

hints: The chosen face is tracked through the clip; frames where it is not found reuse the nearest found frame's position.
A voice track shorter than the video is padded with silence (mouth closed); a longer one is cut to the video's length.
The saved clip's sound is the voice track.
